title: Handle common typos with synonyms
description: Shoppers misspell brand names. Add synonym and fuzzy handling.

comments.author: Priya Nair
comments.body: Applied synonyms at query time, not index time, so the list can change without a reindex.

comments.author: Priya Nair
comments.body: Gotcha: fuzziness above 1 edit returned unrelated products for short words, so we limit it to words with at least five letters.
